segments.ja244:1.4: na hi taṃ lacchati yaṃ sa icchati. 189.

lines: Tattha yaṃ passatīti yaṃ udakādiṃ passati, taṃ gaṅgāti na icchati.
Yañca na passatīti yañca udakādivinimuttaṃ gaṅgaṃ na passati, taṃ kiricchati.
Maññāmi ciraṃ carissatīti ahaṃ evaṃ maññāmi – ayaṃ paribbājako evarūpaṃ gaṅgaṃ pariyesanto ciraṃ carissati.
Yathā vā udakādivinimuttaṃ gaṅgaṃ, evaṃ rūpādivinimuttaṃ attānampi pariyesanto saṃsāre ciraṃ carissati.
Na hi taṃ lacchatīti ciraṃ carantopi yaṃ taṃ evarūpaṃ gaṅgaṃ vā attānaṃ vā icchati, taṃ na lacchati.
Yaṃ labhatīti yaṃ udakaṃ vā rūpādiṃ vā labhati, tena na tussati.
Yañca pattheti laddhaṃ hīḷetīti evaṃ laddhena atussanto yaṃ yaṃ sampattiṃ pattheti, taṃ taṃ labhitvā “kiṃ etāyā”ti hīḷeti avamaññati.
Icchā hi anantagocarāti laddhaṃ hīḷetvā aññamaññaṃ ārammaṇaṃ icchanato ayaṃ icchā nāma taṇhā anantagocarā.
Vigaticchāna namo karomaseti tasmā ye vigaticchā buddhādayo, tesaṃ mayaṃ namakkāraṃ karomāti.
ekaṃ nāma kinti ca bhagavā yasmiṃ ekadhammasmiṃ bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno anupubbena dukkhasantakaro hoti.
taṃ dhammaṃ sandhāya paŭhaṃ pucchitassāyaṃ paŭhāya visajjanā sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikāti.
vutteŭhataṃ bhagavatā — ekadhamme bhikkhave bhikkhu sammānibbindamāno sammāvirajjamāno sammāvimuccamāno sammāpariyantadassāvī sammattaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭhevadhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti.
imasmiṃ kho bhikkhave ekadhamme bhikkhu sammānibbindamāno (pa) dukkhassantakaro hoti.
“eko peŭhā eko uddeso ekaṃ veyyākaraṇa”nti iti yaṃ vuttaṃ.
vaṇṇagandhaparibhāvitanti vaṇṇagandhasampannatāya kaṭukaphalādīhi ca candanādīhi ca paribhāvitaṃ.
kiṃ nukho pārimatīraṃ gaṅgā nāmāti evamāhāti attho.
bodhisatto taṃ pana paribbājakaṃ evamahāti sambandho.
idāni aparampi upameyyopamānaṃ vasena gahetabbaṃ atthaṃ dassetuṃ — yathā vāti ādimāha.
tattha udakādivinimuttaṃ gaṅgaṃ pariyesanto viya ayaṃ paribbājako rūpādivinimuttaṃ rūpādipañcakkhandhavinimuttaṃ attānaṃ pariyesanto saṃsāre cirakālaṃ carissatīti attho.
